hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); is_destructive=0; case "$cmd" in *'git reset --hard'*|*'git clean -f'*|*'git stash drop'*|*'git stash clear'*|*'git branch -D'*|*'rm -rf'*) is_destructive=1;; esac; printf '%s\n' "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git push.+(-f\b|--force)' && is_destructive=1 || true; if [ "$is_destructive" -eq 1 ]; then BLOCKED_CMD="$cmd" python3 -c "import json,os; print(json.dumps({'permissionDecision':'deny','additionalContext':'Destructive command blocked — confirm with user before running: '+os.environ.get('BLOCKED_CMD','')}))"; fi
